 Lakshya Sen vs Alwi Farhan LIVE streaming info: Where to watch Japan Masters 2026 men’s singles semifinal? 
 Japan Masters 2026 live streaming: Here’s where to watch the men’s singles semifinal between Lakshya Sen and Alwi Farhan on Saturday.

 India’s Lakshya Sen will look to secure a place in the final of the Japan Masters 2026 when he takes on Indonesia’s Alwi Farhan in the men’s singles semifinal on Saturday.
 Lakshya, currently ranked World No. 13, comes into the contest on the back of his title-winning run at the Hylo Open 2026 on November 1. He has now reached the semifinals of two successive tournaments, having withdrawn from the Korea Open in between.
 The Indian secured his semifinal spot with a straight-games victory over Japan’s Yushi Tanaka, winning 21-16, 21-15.
 Farhan, the World No. 10, has faced Lakshya twice before and won both encounters in straight games.
 LIVE STREAMING INFO 
 When is the Lakshya Sen vs Alwi Farhan Japan Masters 2026 semifinal? 
 The Lakshya Sen vs Alwi Farhan Japan Masters 2026 semifinal will begin at approximately 7:20am IST (10:50pm local time) on Court 1 at the Kumamoto Prefectural Gymnasium on November 14, Saturday.
 Where to watch the Lakshya Sen vs Yushi Tanaka Japan Masters 2026 quarterfinal LIVE? 
 The Lakshya Sen vs Alwi Farhan Japan Masters 2026 semifinal will be streamed on the BWF TV YouTube channel and Fancode .
